evals.prompt: Set up issue tracking for a new project. I want to use the file-based backend. The project is called 'myapp', a Python web service. No special labels needed beyond the defaults.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker setup mode offers file-based as recommended, confirms default labels, writes setup-issue-tracker.md with backend=file, path=.kodit/issues, and the five default labels. Does NOT create .kodit/issues/.
expectations: Offers file-based as the recommended backend
Confirms the five default labels
Writes .kodit/tmp/setup-issue-tracker.md with type=file
Does not create .kodit/issues/ yet (that happens in provision mode)
Records path as .kodit/issues

evals.prompt: Set up issue tracking for a new project. I want to use Linear. We have a team called 'TEST' in the 'invoque' workspace and I want the project to be called 'taskflow'. I have the Linear MCP connected with write access.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker setup mode verifies the invoque workspace exists, resolves team TEST to its ID, confirms project name, writes setup-issue-tracker.md with type=linear, workspace=invoque, team={key:TEST, id:<resolved>}, linear_project={name:taskflow}, and default labels. Does NOT create any Linear resources.
expectations: Offers Linear as the selected backend
Verifies the invoque workspace exists
Resolves team TEST to its ID within invoque
Confirms project name 'taskflow'
Runs access preflight and confirms MCP write capability
Writes .kodit/tmp/setup-issue-tracker.md with type=linear
Records workspace=invoque and team with key=TEST and resolved id
Records linear_project with name=taskflow
Includes default labels in the draft
Does NOT create any Linear resources (project, states, labels)

evals.prompt: Set up issue tracking for a new project. I want to use Linear, but I don't have any Linear integration set up. My workspace is 'sandbox' and my team is 'EVAL'.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker setup mode detects no MCP or CLI, reports the two remediation paths (connect MCP or install CLI), offers file-based as the alternative, and stops without writing a draft.
expectations: Detects that no Linear integration is available
Reports the two remediation paths
Offers file-based as the alternative
Does not write a setup draft without confirmed access
Does not create any Linear resources

evals.prompt: I have a Linear setup draft from earlier at .kodit/tmp/setup-issue-tracker.md. Provision the issue tracker resources now. Note there is no kodit.json yet.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker provision mode reads the setup draft, creates or finds the Linear project in the invoque workspace under team TEST, ensures required workflow states exist for TEST, creates labels if missing, appends the resolved project ID to the draft, and reports what was created or verified. No kodit.json is read or written. All operations target invoque/TEST explicitly.
expectations: Reads the setup draft (.kodit/tmp/setup-issue-tracker.md) as source of truth
Does not read or require kodit.json
Verifies workspace=invoque and team.id are present in the draft
Creates or finds the Linear project within invoque/TEST
Appends the resolved project ID to the draft
Does not write kodit.json
Ensures the Blocked workflow state exists for team TEST
Verifies required workflow states exist for team TEST
Creates labels if missing in invoque/TEST
Reports what was created or verified
Does not create .kodit/issues/
Does not create resources in any workspace other than invoque
Does not create resources for any team other than TEST

evals.prompt: I have a file-based setup draft at .kodit/tmp/setup-issue-tracker.md. Provision the issue tracker resources now. Note there is no kodit.json yet.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker provision mode creates .kodit/issues/ with README.md and INDEX.md from the file-based conventions. Does not create milestones or stories.
expectations: Creates .kodit/issues/ directory
Creates README.md with file-based conventions
Creates INDEX.md with project charter
Does not create milestones or stories
Reports what was created
